reference_sql:
SELECT store_code, order_month, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_orders
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY store_code, order_month
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) < 350
ORDER BY store_code, order_month
alternatives: SELECT store_code, order_month, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_orders FROM sales WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY store_code, order_month HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) <= 349 ORDER BY store_code ASC, order_month ASC
